key_impacts: Loss of life and property reported across the state.
Basic services were disrupted for months.
Fatalities occurred in Kedarnath on 17 June 2013 as the Mandakini River swept across the town.
Households lost breadwinners, placing children’s education and livelihoods at risk.
missing_information: Exact start/end dates for the broader disaster period not specified.

key_impacts: The State Primary School building in Farkia was destroyed (reduced to rubble).
Classes were disrupted for two weeks and held in makeshift locations.
From 13 August the school was moved to Panchayat premises, where damp conditions impeded teaching and learning.
Seven months after the landslide there was still no indication that reconstruction had begun.
missing_information: Year for the 13 July landslide not explicitly stated; inferred as 2013 from context.
